facts.fact: Ghana's Data Protection Commission ran an enforcement operation on 2026-10-12 and directed Nyaho Medical Centre to report to the Police CID over its expired data protection registration certificate, under the Data Protection Act, 2012 (Act 843), per MyJoyOnline.
MyJoyOnline says organisations processing personal data must meet registration obligations under the Data Protection Act, 2012 (Act 843), which the DPC enforced on 2026-10-12.

Ghana's Data Protection Commission ran an enforcement operation on 2026-10-12 and directed Nyaho Medical Centre to report to the Police CID over its expired data protection registration certificate, under the Data Protection Act, 2012 (Act 843), per MyJoyOnline. No sanction was stated.
